body.purpose: Tab labels, nav links, insight prose, query answers.

changelog.summary: Information-architecture revision: single continuous scroll (with sidebar scroll-spy nav) replaced by a four-tab ARIA tabs widget (Overview/Trends/Breakdowns/Insights) with count badges; sidebar's schematic connector nav retired; KPI grid changed from CSS Grid to Flexbox for even last-row stretch; chart/panel heights bounded to fix print/PDF page-break slicing. Colors, typography, and component tokens unchanged.

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Primary navigation, added 2026-09-17. ARIA tablist of four top-level sections (Overview/Trends/Breakdowns/Insights) with mono tabular-nums count badges; replaced the sidebar scroll-spy nav now that content is tabbed rather than one continuous scroll. The Insights badge turns danger-colored when at least one insight is critical.
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.35rem; margin-bottom: 1.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(16,20,26,0.13); } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600; color: #5c6470; background: none; border: none; padding: 0.75rem 0.2rem; margin-right: 1.25rem; cursor: pointer; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transform: translateY(1px); transition: color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #10141a; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0891a8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab-active { color: #10141a; border-bottom-color: #0891a8; } .ds-tab-count { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; color: #5c6470; background: rgba(16,20,26,0.13); border-radius: 5px; padding: 0.05rem 0.4rem; } .ds-tab-active .ds-tab-count { color: #0891a8; background: rgba(8,145,168,0.12); } .ds-tab-attention .ds-tab-count { color: #c23a3a; background: rgba(194,58,58,0.12); }

components.name: KPI Card
components.description: Hairline-grid cell showing a KPI's mono numeral value and mono comparison badge; no per-card border or shadow. Changed 2026-09-17 from a CSS Grid (auto-fit, minmax(200px,1fr)) to a Flexbox row (flex: 1 1 220px) so a partial last row stretches evenly instead of leaving a short ragged row.
components.css: .ds-kpi-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1px; background: rgba(16,20,26,0.13); border: 1px solid rgba(16,20,26,0.13); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-kpi-card { flex: 1 1 220px; border: none; padding: 1.35rem 1.4rem; background: #fbfbfa; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-kpi-card:hover, .ds-kpi-card:focus-visible { background: #ffffff; } .ds-kpi-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0891a8; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-kpi-label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #5c6470; margin-bottom: 0.65rem; } .ds-kpi-value { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 1.85rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-kpi-badge { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; display: inline-flex; margin-top: 0.6rem; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 0.15rem 0.4rem; border-radius: 5px; color: #1a7a4c; background: rgba(26,122,76,0.12); }

• [i]Revenue up 4.2% — driven by higher order volume in March.
  • [x]Delivery rate dropped — on-time rate fell below threshold.
components.css: .ds-insight-list { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border: 1px solid rgba(16,20,26,0.13); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-insight { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.1rem; background: #fbfbfa; font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-insight + .ds-insight { border-top: 1px solid rgba(16,20,26,0.13); } .ds-insight-tag { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; flex-shrink: 0; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-insight-info .ds-insight-tag { color: #0891a8; } .ds-insight-critical .ds-insight-tag { color: #c23a3a; }

narrative.overview: BIFlow's product truth is that every KPI is a formula, run by an auditable agent, not a black box — so the dashboard is built as an instrument panel / lab-ledger, not a generic SaaS card grid. Surfaces are flat lab-paper (light) or dark-instrument black (dark, via prefers-color-scheme), separated by hairline rules rather than floating shadows, with one committed signal-cyan accent reserved strictly for "this is live." The confirmed anti-reference is the prior dashboard generation (adaptive theme, soft nav highlight, stat-tile cards with individual shadows) — that shell is explicitly not the target; this system replaces its soft highlight sidebar with a schematic connector line, and its floating cards with a shared-hairline grid. The signature move is the type split: every numeral — KPI values, chart axis ticks and tooltips, timestamps — is set in IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals, while every label, heading, and sentence of prose runs in Geist Sans. This isn't decorative; it makes "this number was computed, not guessed" legible at a glance, which is the whole pitch of a multi-agent pipeline that traces numbers back to formulas. Density is close but not cramped: a fixed 280px sidebar and fixed 400px query drawer bracket a fluid, capped-width reading column, so the KPI grid, trend/breakdown charts, and insight ledger all read as instrument readouts rather than dashboard widgets. 2026-09-17 — information architecture revision: colors, typography, and component tokens are unchanged; the reading column moved from one continuous scroll (sidebar scroll-spy nav) to a four-tab ARIA tabs widget (Overview/Trends/Breakdowns/Insights), and the sidebar's schematic connector nav was retired since there is no longer a single scrolling page for it to track.
keyCharacteristics: Flat lab-paper/instrument-black surfaces, hairline-separated, not shadow-separated
One signal-cyan accent, reserved for "live" state only
Numerals in IBM Plex Mono (tabular), everything else in Geist Sans
Tightened radii (5/8/10px) read as instrument-panel, not bubbly SaaS
Insight severity and KPI formulas are typographic ledger marks, not colored side-tabs
Content is organized as four ARIA tabs (Overview/Trends/Breakdowns/Insights), not a single scrolling page

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal-cyan means "live" and nothing else: active tab/nav state, focus, and the formula label. It never represents success, warning, or danger, and status colors never borrow it — so a viewer can always read cyan as "this is the thing currently active," not as a fourth status color.

rules.name: The Mono-Numerals Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a measured or timestamped value — KPI values, chart ticks/tooltips, percent-change badges, tab counts, "Updated" timestamps — is set in IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals. Anything that is a label, heading, or sentence is Geist Sans. No component mixes the two within the same text run.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat and hairline-bordered at rest. The one shadow that ships (--shadow-lg on the KPI detail flyout) marks the one panel that is genuinely a layer above the grid, not a decorative default.

dos: Do set every KPI value, chart tick/tooltip, comparison percentage, tab count, and timestamp in IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums; set everything else in Geist Sans.
Do reserve signal-cyan for live/active state only (tabs, nav, focus, formula label) — never repurpose it as a fourth status color.
Do separate cards and grid cells with 1px hairlines and shared-gap grids rather than individual shadows; reserve --shadow-lg for the one genuinely lifted surface (the KPI detail flyout).
Do use monospace bracket tags ([i]/[!]/[x]) for insight severity and dashed-rule ledger framing for formula/explanation content.
Do bound any variable-height list or chart (max-height + internal scroll, or a capped pixel formula) rather than letting a tab panel grow into an unbounded page.
donts: Don't add colored left-border "side-tab" accents to cards, list items, or callouts — this system replaced that exact pattern (insight rows, the explanation block, query-history turns) with bracket tags and dashed rules; do not reintroduce it on new surfaces.
Don't use hard offset/neobrutalist shadows anywhere in this system — the shadow vocabulary is soft and blurred, and used sparingly.

Don't apply the "§ Overview" mono section-label kicker uniformly above every heading — recorded as the rule, but the shipped CSS already applies it to all four tab panel headings; this drift is flagged, not repaired or promoted.
Don't reintroduce a scroll-spy sidebar nav (connector line + section dots) now that content is tabbed — use the tab bar for section navigation instead.
